warnings: Rule 4H SKIP: existing gas water heater stays (confirmed.md round 1 q.tankless_wh_in_base_bid). No procurement.tank / plumbing.tank_set task emitted. If PM flips to the $6,500 tankless add-on, task_graph must be rebuilt to add those and re-order MEP predecessors.

Rule 4Q SKIP: no procurement.trusses emitted. 789 SF footprint and ~10 ft roof span are well under the 800 SF / 24 ft belief thresholds; stick-frame lumber arrives with framing crew day-of (belief stick_frame_default_for_small_additions).
plumbing_rough_min_duration OVERRIDE: CSV row 20 = 40 labor hrs (~2.5d) violates the 4-day hard floor. plumbing.rough duration set to 4d × 2 crew per the rule; do NOT drop below.

CSV row 26 anomaly (negative material −$4,199): per dev_rules §12, not expanded into a full task tree. Represented as one closeout task (closeout.punch_final_clean) + one retrofit task (hall_bath.window_infill_patch) + the Day-1 customer early item (customer_early.hall_bath_acrylic_shower_swap).

Rule 4V two-bucket confirmed: hall bath acrylic shower swap is Day-1 early item in component customer_early_items; hall bath window infill/patch runs later in hall_bath_mod component (confirmed.md round 1 q.hall_bath_acrylic_shower_early_item).

Windows procurement follows plans schedule (2 new: 3'0"×1'0" transom + 3'0"×3'0" DH), NOT scope narrative's "(3) 36×60 + transom." Existing Bedroom 2/3 windows are relocated (no procurement). Order MUST reference confirmed.md before placing (plans.md Discrepancy #1; confirmed.md q.windows_count_and_size_reconciliation).

Brick veneer DROPPED: plans elevation note "NEW BRICK TO MATCH EXISTING" is stale design intent; vinyl siding only (confirmed.md q.brick_veneer_addition_base). No masonry sub or brick materials in exterior.siding_trim task.
Closet & Cabinet System optional package ($7,000) is OUT of base scope. No cabinets.install task emitted. If PM signs the add-on, re-run task_graph (confirmed.md q.closet_cabinet_optional_package).

Interior doors verification NEEDED: working assumption is 2 pocket (hall bath + primary closet) + pre-hung panel remainder, but plans door schedule shows only PANEL doors — no pocket callouts. PM must eyeball drawings before framing.exterior_walls to size pocket-door rough openings (plans.md Discrepancy #3; confirmed.md q.interior_doors_pocket_vs_panel).

Roof tie-in discovery buffer: 3/12 new tying into existing 6/12 with valleys + existing chimney is a known concealed-conditions seam. framing.roof_tie_in_discovery is SS with framing.roof to surface tie-in details early (plans.md Discrepancy #5; breakdown.md silent omission #6). Change-order risk if concealed conditions surface.

Rule 4N interior-trade cap: only 2 interior trades concurrent. Scheduler MUST stagger — mini-split install serialized AFTER electrical.finish to avoid electrical + plumbing + HVAC 3-way overlap during finish phase.
Rule 4C bundled inspection: inspect.rough_bundled is ONE task, ONE inspector, ONE day covering framing + plumbing + electrical + HVAC. Do NOT split per-trade.
Rule 4A permits: general.permitting is kind:work (1d) with pre_construction_offset_working_days:15 — NOT kind:lead_time.

TDEC septic offset 30 calendar-day pre-construction acknowledgment ONLY. Existing septic is adequate; no septic replacement/tank/leach field/grinder work in scope (confirmed.md q.septic_grinder_direction, rule tdec_septic_permit_offset).
Elevator shaft framing + 30A elevator circuit folded silently into framing.exterior_walls (row 15) and electrical.rough (row 19) per breakdown.md silent omission #3 — no standalone tasks.

Grand Total on CSV ($100,778.92) is raw cost; scope's $173,850 is customer-facing contract (with markup + overhead). Duration math trusted CSV labor hours (1,287 total), NOT the contract dollar figure.
